orbit_height.dcep_description: Orbit altitude above Earth surface. Determines sc_type via priority chain: LEO if altitude <= 2000 km.

thrust_mode.dcep_description: high: restricts evolver to high-thrust/low-Isp technologies. low: restricts to low-thrust/high-Isp (EP). any or empty: no restriction.

mass_total.dcep_description: Total wet mass. Upper quartile of LEO database: min=25 kg, max=16221 kg, high=12000 kg.

deltav.dcep_description: Orbit raising, collision avoidance and disposal budget

propulsion_power.dcep_description: Power available for propulsion system (5 kW/tonne typical Hall EP)

propulsion_time_fraction.dcep_description: 1% duty cycle: short aggressive burns, drives high thrust_min
